objective: Εντόπισε website templates κατάλληλα για ελληνική ταβέρνα/εστιατόριο. Για κάθε υποψήφιο κατέγραψε: όνομα, repo/URL, άδεια όπως δηλώνεται, αν είναι customer-facing site εστιατορίου (όχι app/dashboard/portfolio), και αν το design είναι του ίδιου του δημιουργού. Απόρριψε aggregators, φοιτητικά project μαθημάτων, και ό,τι δεν έχει ρητή άδεια.

findings.name: Grecko
findings.purpose: Restaurant website template built with Bootstrap 4, fully responsive with full-screen slider, menu pages, gallery, custom Google map, and optimized image delivery.
findings.why_relevant: MIT-licensed customer-facing restaurant site with menu pages, map, and responsive design, suitable as a starting point for a Greek taverna conversion to booking, phone, and directions.
findings.pass1_reason: MIT licensed restaurant Bootstrap template, customer-facing site

findings.name: Sweet Bakery
findings.purpose: Free bakery/café website template from Tooplate
findings.why_relevant: Not usable for Vitrina because it lacks an explicit open-source license, conflicting with MIT/permissive requirement.
findings.pass1_reason: Free bakery/café template, no open-source license
findings.license_source: No GitHub reference to verify against
